current.text: Portland's guard group is crowded. Lillard, Morant, Holiday, Henderson and Avdija all handle the ball. He is not in the projected starting five: Henderson, Lillard, Camara, Avdija and Clingan.
Portland's rotation is thin after the eighth man, especially at forward. Avdija and Camara are close to the only true forwards.
Portland has a first-time head coach. Minutes and usage are expected to swing from game to game across the rotation.
Portland plays 10 games in our playoff weeks, a weak schedule, with three back-to-backs in the fantasy playoffs.
